## North Carolina November 3, 2026 Election Results

Download precinct-level results from the [North Carolina State Board of Elections](https://www.ncsbe.gov/results-data/election-results/historical-election-results-data):

- [Precinct-level results (tab-delimited TXT)](data/results_pct_20261103.txt)
- [Original results archive (ZIP)](data/results_pct_20261103.zip)

## NC House District Results

This is an original estimate inspired by [NCFREE's map of Roy Cooper's Senate margin by House district](https://ncfree.org/2026/11/election-night-2026-the-extended-cut/). The article does not publish a district-level data table. Here, Senate votes from each county/precinct location are allocated across House districts in proportion to the NC House votes at that location. This is approximate, especially for early-voting sites, and is not NCFREE's estimate. Positive margins favor Cooper; the margin is the Democratic minus Republican share of all votes. This uses the downloaded NCSBE results, not the article's Nov. 4 snapshot. District boundaries are from the [2024 U.S. Census TIGER/Line state legislative district files](https://www2.census.gov/geo/tiger/TIGER2024/SLDL/tl_2024_37_sldl.zip).

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)

results <- read_tsv("data/results_pct_20261103.txt", show_col_types = FALSE)

location_columns <- c("County", "Precinct", "Real Precinct")

house_weights <- results |>
  filter(str_detect(`Contest Name`, "^NC HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES DISTRICT")) |>
  mutate(district = as.integer(str_extract(`Contest Name`, "\\d+$"))) |>
  group_by(across(all_of(location_columns)), district) |>
  summarise(house_votes = sum(`Total Votes`), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(house_votes > 0) |>
  group_by(across(all_of(location_columns))) |>
  mutate(weight = house_votes / sum(house_votes)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(all_of(location_columns), district, weight)

senate_by_district <- results |>
  filter(`Contest Name` == "US SENATE") |>
  inner_join(
    house_weights,
    by = location_columns,
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) |>
  mutate(allocated_votes = `Total Votes` * weight) |>
  group_by(district) |>
  summarise(
    democratic_votes = sum(allocated_votes[`Choice Party` == "DEM"]),
    republican_votes = sum(allocated_votes[`Choice Party` == "REP"]),
    total_votes = sum(allocated_votes),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(cooper_margin = 100 * (democratic_votes - republican_votes) / total_votes)

house_districts <- st_read(
  "data/house_districts/tl_2024_37_sldl.shp",
  quiet = TRUE
) |>
  mutate(district = as.integer(SLDLST)) |>
  left_join(senate_by_district, by = "district") |>
  st_transform("EPSG:5070")

district_labels <- st_sf(
  district = house_districts$district,
  geometry = st_point_on_surface(st_geometry(house_districts))
)

ggplot(house_districts) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = cooper_margin), color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  geom_sf_text(
    data = district_labels,
    aes(label = district),
    size = 1.5,
    check_overlap = TRUE,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#B2182B",
    mid = "#F7F7F7",
    high = "#2166AC",
    midpoint = 0,
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1),
    name = "Margin (percentage points)",
    guide = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top")
  ) +
  coord_sf(datum = NA, expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Estimated Roy Cooper margin in each NC House district",
    subtitle = "2026 U.S. Senate; positive margins favor Cooper",
    caption = "Sources: NC State Board of Elections; 2024 U.S. Census TIGER/Line boundaries."
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
